Let Chill Out Sailing be your sanctuary for relaxation and self-care. Unwind, recharge, and indulge in ultimate tranquility amidst the serene waters. blurb: Chill Out Sailing offers yacht charters and hosts events such as weddings, corporate gatherings, wellness days, and parties aboard luxury yachts and catamarans. They operate in Long Beach and Marina del Rey with a fleet of boats suited for various group sizes and event types. Their services include event planning, catering, and professional crew with US Coast Guard licensed captains.
